# StarLayer API Overview (generated)

Generated directly from `packages/starlayer/starlayer/codekg/codekg.trig` - every PublicAccess entity's own headline sentence(s), nothing hand-curated. Each name links to its full entry in [api-reference.generated.md](api-reference.generated.md).

## `starlayer`

- **[`StarLayerDataset`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset)** (class) - An RDF dataset where every named-graph context is a StarLayerGraph.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.add`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-add)** (method) - Add a triple to the default graph, or a quad ``(s, p, o, graph)`` to the graph it names, with TripleTerm-aware encoding - see this section's own module-level comment for why this override exists at all.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.addN`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-addN)** (method) - Add multiple quads, each routed to its own target graph's real StarLayerGraph context for TripleTerm-aware encoding - see this section's own module-level comment.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.cbd`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-cbd)** (method) - Computes the Concise Bounded Description of ``resource`` and returns it as a ``StarLayerGraph``.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.close`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-close)** (method) - Close the underlying store, optionally committing pending writes.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.contexts`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-contexts)** (method) - Yield a StarLayerGraph for every named graph in this dataset.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.de_skolemize`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-de_skolemize)** (method) - Convert skolem IRIs back to blank nodes. Same bug class and same fix as skolemize() above.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.default_context`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-default_context)** (method) - Deprecated alias for default_graph (matches rdflib's own deprecation).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.default_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-default_graph)** (method) - The default graph context, re-resolved via get_context() on every access - never cached as self._default_context directly.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.get_context`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-get_context)** (method) - Return the StarLayerGraph for the named graph with the given identifier.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.open`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-open)** (method) - Open a persistent store and rebuild all per-context TripleTerm registries. Returns self, not whatever status value rdflib's own Graph.open() returns (fixed 2026-10-04 - same bug as StarLayerGraph.open()).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.parse`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-parse)** (method) - Parse RDF data into named-graph contexts.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.quads`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-quads)** (method) - Yield (s, p, o, StarLayerGraph) with encoding triples filtered out and tt:HASH URIRefs restored to TripleTerm objects.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.query`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-query)** (method) - Execute a SPARQL query across all named graphs with SPARQL-star support.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reduce_prefixes`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-reduce_prefixes)** (method) - A copy of this dataset whose namespace bindings are only the ones in use (see ``used_prefixes()``), plus any prefix named in ``keep`` that this dataset has bound. Every graph keeps its triples and its name.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reifications`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-reifications)** (method) - Return a StarLayerDataset of the rdf:reifies triples for every reified triple term matching the given s/p/o pattern, across every graph in this dataset - see StarLayerGraph.reifications().
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reified_triples`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-reified_triples)** (method) - Return a StarLayerDataset of the rdf:reifies triples for the given reifier node, across every graph in this dataset - a reifier node reused in more than one graph shows up as a separate match per graph. See StarLayerGraph.reified_triples().
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reifier_annotations`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-reifier_annotations)** (method) - Return a StarLayerDataset of annotation triples for every reifier of TT, across every graph in this dataset.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reifiers`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-reifiers)** (method) - Return a StarLayerDataset of every matching reifier's full triples, across every graph in this dataset.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.remove`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-remove)** (method) - Remove a triple, or a quad ``(s, p, o, graph)`` from the graph it names.

- **[`StarLayerDataset.triples_choices`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-triples_choices)** (method) - Iterate triples matching a choices pattern, scoped the same way ``triples()`` above is. Filters encoding triples; restores TripleTerms.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.unbind`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-unbind)** (method) - Take the binding of ``prefix`` away; True if it was bound. rdflib has no such call: the binding is removed from the store's own prefix map (in-memory and ``OxigraphStore`` stores; any other raises ``NotImplementedError``, copy with ``reduce_prefixes()`` there). Graphs that share this store lose the prefix too (GitHub issue #44).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.update`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-update)** (method) - Execute a SPARQL UPDATE across named graphs with SPARQL-star support.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.used_prefixes`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_dataset-StarLayerDataset-used_prefixes)** (method) - The namespace bindings of this dataset that matter: ``(prefix, namespace)`` pairs, sorted by prefix, for the namespaces an IRI in any graph of the dataset is in, or a named graph's own name (TriG writes it). Graphs that share this store lose the prefix too (GitHub issue #44).
- **[`StarLayerGraph.update`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_graph-StarLayerGraph-update)** (method) - Execute a SPARQL UPDATE.
- **[`StarLayerGraph.used_prefixes`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_graph-StarLayerGraph-used_prefixes)** (method) - The namespace bindings of this graph that matter: ``(prefix, namespace)`` pairs, sorted by prefix, for the namespaces an IRI of the graph is in (a subject, predicate or object, a literal's datatype, any part of a triple term). The ~29 default prefixes rdflib binds to every graph, and prefixes the source declared but never used, are left out; ``rdf:type`` as a predicate does not count, since Turtle writes it ``a``. ## `starlayer.graph`

- **[`CanonicalizationComplexityError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-rdfc-CanonicalizationComplexityError)** (class) - Raised when canonicalizing would require exploring more permutations than the configured budget.
- **[`DirLangString`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-dirlangstring-DirLangString)** (class) - An RDF 1.2 directional language-tagged string literal.
- **[`DirLangString.n3`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-dirlangstring-DirLangString-n3)** (method) - Returns the N3/Turtle-1.2 (``"text"@lang--dir``) text form.
- **[`TripleTerm`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-triple-TripleTerm)** (class) - An RDF 1.2 triple term — a triple used as a resource.
- **[`TripleTerm.n3`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-triple-TripleTerm-n3)** (method) - Returns the N3/Turtle-1.2 (``<<( s p o )>>``) text form.
- **[`Turtle12SyntaxError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-parsers-errors-Turtle12SyntaxError)** (class) - Malformed Turtle 1.2 input that the parser cannot recognize as any valid token or statement form.
- **[`can_resolve_import`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-graph-starlayer_graph-can_resolve_import)** (function) - Returns whether ``loader`` can resolve ``iri``.
- **[`graph_diff`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-compare-graph_diff)** (function) - RDF-1.2-aware replacement for ``rdflib.compare.graph_diff``.
- **[`isomorphic`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-compare-isomorphic)** (function) - RDF-1.2-aware replacement for ``rdflib.compare.isomorphic`` - correct for graphs containing triple terms (including ones with nested blank nodes), identical to the original for graphs that don't. Also RDF 1.1-correct for simple-literal-vs-explicit-``xsd:string`` (see module docstring): a plain ``Literal("x")`` and ``Literal("x", datatype=XSD.string)`` compare equal here, unlike in plain ``rdflib.compare.isomorphic``.

- **[`parseUpdate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-query-sparql_api-parseUpdate)** (function) - Parse a SPARQL 1.2 Update request string.
- **[`prepareQuery`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-query-sparql_api-prepareQuery)** (function) - Parse and translate a SPARQL 1.2 query string to an rdflib ``Query`` object.
- **[`prepareUpdate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-query-sparql_api-prepareUpdate)** (function) - Parse and translate a SPARQL 1.2 Update request string to an rdflib ``Update`` object.
- **[`processUpdate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-query-sparql_api-processUpdate)** (function) - Execute a SPARQL 1.2 Update against a graph.

- **[`serialize_longturtle12`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-serializers-turtle12-serialize_longturtle12)** (function) - Serialize a StarLayerGraph to longturtle 1.2 — one triple per line.
- **[`serialize_nquads12`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-serializers-ntriples12-serialize_nquads12)** (function) - Serialize a StarLayerGraph to N-Quads 1.2 text.
- **[`serialize_ntriples12`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-serializers-ntriples12-serialize_ntriples12)** (function) - Serialize a StarLayerGraph to N-Triples 1.2 text.

## `starlayer.sparql`

- **[`prepare_query_12`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-parse12-prepare_query_12)** (function) - Parses and translates SPARQL 1.2 query text into a real, executable-shaped rdflib ``Query``.
- **[`prepare_update_12`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-parse12-prepare_update_12)** (function) - ``prepare_query_12``'s counterpart for SPARQL 1.2 Update text — same ``base``/``initNs`` passthrough to ``translateUpdate``.
- **[`queries_to_collection`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-to_rdf-queries_to_collection)** (function) - Encodes a list of independent, prepared rdflib ``Query`` objects as one RDF ``salg:QueryCollection``.
- **[`query_to_rdf`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-to_rdf-query_to_rdf)** (function) - Encode a prepared rdflib ``Query`` (from ``prepareQuery``/``translateQuery``, starlayer.graph's SPARQL-1.2-aware variants included) as RDF triples.
- **[`rdf_to_collection`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-from_rdf-rdf_to_collection)** (function) - Decode ``root`` (as produced by ``to_rdf.queries_to_collection``) back into a list of independent, directly executable rdflib ``Query`` objects, in the same order they were encoded.
- **[`rdf_to_query`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-from_rdf-rdf_to_query)** (function) - Decode ``root`` (as produced by ``to_rdf.query_to_rdf``) back into an rdflib ``Query`` — same type ``prepareQuery``/``translateQuery`` return.
- **[`rdf_to_update`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-from_rdf-rdf_to_update)** (function) - Decode ``root`` (as produced by ``to_rdf.update_to_rdf``) back into an rdflib ``Update`` — same type ``prepareUpdate``/``translateUpdate`` return, runnable via ``rdflib.plugins.sparql.update.evalUpdate``.
- **[`rewrite_algebra_for_rdf`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-entailment_rdf-rewrite_algebra_for_rdf)** (function) - Return ``algebra`` with every BGP rewritten for RDF entailment (see module docstring for exactly which rule). Mutates and returns the same tree (matching ``rdflib.plugins.sparql.algebra.traverse``'s own contract) - idempotent, since every triple this rewrite produces uses a fresh ``__starlayer_rdf_N`` variable in a slot that never matches the ``p == RDF.type and o == RDF.Property`` trigger a second time (the fresh predicate variable is never literally ``rdf:Property``).
- **[`rewrite_algebra_for_rdfs`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-entailment_rdfs-rewrite_algebra_for_rdfs)** (function) - Return ``algebra`` with every BGP rewritten for RDFS entailment (see module docstring for exactly which rules). Mutates and returns the same tree (matching ``rdflib.plugins.sparql.algebra.traverse``'s own contract, already relied on elsewhere in this codebase's lowering passes) - idempotent, since every triple this rewrite produces uses either a ``Path`` object or a fresh ``__starlayer_rdfs_N`` variable in predicate position, neither of which matches the ``p == RDF.type`` / ``isinstance(p, URIRef)`` checks that trigger rewriting on a second pass.
- **[`update_to_rdf`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-to_rdf-update_to_rdf)** (function) - Encode a prepared rdflib ``Update`` (from ``prepareUpdate``/ ``translateUpdate``) as RDF triples.

## `starlayer.sparql.salg`

- **[`UnboundProjectedVariable`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-salg-semantic_checks-UnboundProjectedVariable)** (class) - One `Project` node whose `PV` names a variable never bound anywhere in its own pattern subtree.
- **[`find_unbound_projected_variables`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-salg-semantic_checks-find_unbound_projected_variables)** (function) - Returns every ``UnboundProjectedVariable`` finding in ``data_graph``.
- **[`ontology_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-salg-sparql_ontology-ontology_graph)** (function) - Build a fresh graph: the RDFS ontology in ``salg-ontology.ttl`` merged with ``spexpr-ontology.ttl`` (lives in the ``starontology`` package).

## `starlayer.sparql.sqe`

- **[`SQEError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-sqe-to_rdf-SQEError)** (class) - Base class for every ``sqe:``-specific exception (``SQEValidationError`` here) - gives a caller two real catch granularities, "this specific failure" vs. "any ``sqe:`` failure", the same two-tier shape ``srl.py``'s own ``SRLError``/ ``SRLParseError`` already established for the identical reason.
- **[`SQEValidationError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-sqe-to_rdf-SQEValidationError)** (class) - Raised by :func:`sqe_parse_to_tree` when the text parses fine but the resulting ``sqe:`` tree fails ``sqe:``'s own SHACL shapes (most notably the unbound-projected-variable check) - "this text doesn't produce a usable ``sqe:`` tree", matching the same "succeed with a usable object, or raise" contract ``prepareQuery()``/ ``srl.parse_ruleset()`` already give their own callers, rather than handing back a tree that's already known to be unusable and leaving it to the caller to remember to check.
- **[`sqe_parse_to_tree`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-sqe-to_rdf-sqe_parse_to_tree)** (function) - Encode SPARQL ``SELECT``/``ASK``/``CONSTRUCT`` query text as ``sqe:`` RDF, and validate the result. The one public encoding entry point - parses ``text`` with the same ``parseQuery`` every other SPARQL 1.2 entry point in this package uses, delegates to ``_query_to_sqe_rdf`` below, then validates via :func:`sqe_validate` before returning - a caller only ever gets back a tree already confirmed to satisfy ``sqe:``'s own shapes (including the unbound-projected-variable check), never one silently known to fail.
- **[`sqe_tree_to_query`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-sqe-from_rdf-sqe_tree_to_query)** (function) - Decode ``root`` (one of ``sqe:SelectQuery``/``sqe:AskQuery``/ ``sqe:ConstructQuery``, as produced by ``to_rdf.sqe_parse_to_tree``) back into a real rdflib ``Query``.
- **[`sqe_tree_to_text`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-sparql-sqe-to_text-sqe_tree_to_text)** (function) - Render ``root`` (as produced by ``to_rdf.sqe_parse_to_tree``) back into SPARQL query text, re-abbreviating terms using the ``PREFIX`` declarations preserved on ``root`` wherever one matches.

## `starlayer.shacl`

- **[`ComponentRequest`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-engine-contracts-ComponentRequest)** (class) - One native-component evaluation request - ``evaluate_component()``'s own sole argument.
- **[`ExecutionDiagnostics`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-results-ExecutionDiagnostics)** (class) - Internal adapter bookkeeping for the RDF 1.2 triple-term adaptation layer - not general-purpose validation statistics.
- **[`MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol)** (class) - ``StarLayerGraphProtocol`` plus mutation methods - ``add()``/ ``remove()``.
- **[`MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol.add`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol-add)** (method) - Adds ``triple`` to the graph.
- **[`MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol.remove`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol-remove)** (method) - Removes every triple matching ``triple_pattern`` from the graph.
- **[`RulesResult`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-results-RulesResult)** (class) - Result of ``apply_rules()``.
- **[`StarLayerGraphProtocol`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-StarLayerGraphProtocol)** (class) - Structural protocol every graph-like input to this package must satisfy: a bound ``namespace_manager`` plus iterability over triples.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter)** (class) - Encode/decode triple terms so pySHACL can process RDF 1.1-compatible graphs.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.clear_registry`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-clear_registry)** (method) - Drop every registered triple-term mapping, forward and reverse.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.decode_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-decode_graph)** (method) - Returns the inverse of ``encode_graph()``: a copy of ``graph`` with every encoded term resolved back to its real form.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.decode_term`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-decode_term)** (method) - Decodes a single term the same way ``decode_graph`` decodes one node.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.diagnostics_snapshot`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-diagnostics_snapshot)** (method) - Return a copy of the current diagnostic counters (``encode_graph_calls``, ``decode_graph_calls``, ``encoded_triple_terms``, ``decoded_triple_terms``).
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.encode_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-encode_graph)** (method) - Returns a flat, RDF-1.1-compatible copy of ``graph`` with every triple term and DirLangString literal flattened to plain terms.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.encode_term`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-encode_term)** (method) - Encodes a single term the same way ``encode_graph`` encodes one node - see ``_encode_node``.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.export_registry`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-export_registry)** (method) - Serializes the current registry to a plain JSON-able dict.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.for_starlayer_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-for_starlayer_graph)** (method) - Creates an adapter whose decoded triple terms are real ``starlayer.graph.model.triple.TripleTerm`` instances.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.import_registry`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-import_registry)** (method) - Load a registry previously produced by ``export_registry()``.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.replace_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-replace_graph)** (method) - Replaces every triple in ``target`` with the triples from ``source``, in place.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.reset_diagnostics`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-reset_diagnostics)** (method) - Reset the call/encode/decode counters returned by ``diagnostics_snapshot()`` back to zero, without touching the encode/decode registry itself.
- **[`TripleTermAdapter.support_triple_count`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermAdapter-support_triple_count)** (method) - Return the number of ``rdf:subject``/``rdf:predicate``/ ``rdf:object`` encoding triples this adapter's registry would add to a graph - 3 per registered triple term.
- **[`TripleTermGraph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermGraph)** (class) - Simple graph-like container that can hold triple-term objects directly.
- **[`TripleTermGraph.add`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermGraph-add)** (method) - Adds ``triple`` if not already present, and returns this graph.
- **[`TripleTermGraph.remove`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermGraph-remove)** (method) - Removes every triple matching ``pattern`` and returns this graph.
- **[`TripleTermValue`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-adapters-TripleTermValue)** (class) - The default, dependency-free decoded triple-term value type.
- **[`ValidationResult`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-results-ValidationResult)** (class) - Result of ``validate()`` - a richer replacement for pyshacl's own bare ``(conforms, report_graph, report_text)`` tuple.
- **[`apply_rules`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-apply_rules)** (function) - Executes SHACL rules against a private working copy of ``data_graph``, then validates the resulting evaluation graph.
- **[`build_report`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-engine-core-build_report)** (function) - Builds a ``sh:ValidationReport`` graph from component ``events``.
- **[`declared_conformance_profile`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-profiling-declared_conformance_profile)** (function) - A fresh copy of starlayer.shacl's self-declared SHACL 1.2 conformance statement (S3) - the starlayer.shacl resource in the library's one conformance file. Parses the bundled asset fresh on every call rather than caching - matching this project's convention elsewhere (see starontology/__init__.py::_file_graph) of never sharing one mutable graph object across callers.
- **[`derive_conforms_to`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-profiling-derive_conforms_to)** (function) - Derive ``sh:conformsTo`` triples from a validation report, per SHACL 1.2 Profiling S5.5.
- **[`evaluate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-evaluate)** (function) - Computes every ``sh:values``/``sh:defaultValue``-declared virtual property across ``shacl_graph`` and returns the result as a shape-driven subgraph.
- **[`evaluate_component`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-engine-core-evaluate_component)** (function) - Evaluates one native ``ConstraintComponent`` directly against ``request``'s own focus/value nodes, dispatched by component name.
- **[`extract_subgraph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-subgraph_extraction-extract_subgraph)** (function) - Returns the subgraph covered by one shape+focus_node pair, or by every real entry point a whole shapes graph declares.
- **[`normalize_graph_inputs`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-engine-normalization-normalize_graph_inputs)** (function) - Normalizes a data/shapes/ontology graph, in any shape a caller may pass, to ``StarLayerGraph`` (or ``None``) via ``normalize_to_starlayer_graph()``.
- **[`normalize_to_starlayer_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-engine-normalization-normalize_to_starlayer_graph)** (function) - Normalize input graph to StarLayerGraph.
- **[`target_nodes`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-engine-core-target_nodes)** (function) - Resolve ``shape_node``'s SHACL targets against ``data_graph``.
- **[`validate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-validate)** (function) - Validates ``data_graph`` against ``shacl_graph`` per SHACL 1.2 Core, and returns a ``ValidationResult``.
- **[`validate_each`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-validate_each)** (function) - Validate each graph in ``data_graphs`` against the same ``shacl_graph``/``ont_graph``, by calling the module-level ``validate()`` function above once per item. ``StarShaclSchema.validate_each()`` keeps its own, separate copy of this body for now (see ``validate()``'s own docstring).
